scope: Nine images inspected at original detail; Christ identities compared with approved reference previously inspected. No edits or generation.

candidates.subject: Syrophoenician woman corrected gaze
candidates.gaze: Head angle is improved versus rejected original, but pupils still read approximately sideways above the woman's eye line. The woman's eyes are substantially below Christ's; the rendered gaze still feels directed beyond her rather than unambiguously down toward her eyes. This does not yet fully resolve the original finding.
candidates.anatomy: Visible hands, legs and feet remain plausible.
candidates.recommendation: Keep scene and identity, direct both pupils distinctly down-left to the woman's eye position. Require visibly reciprocal eye contact. A crop detail review is appropriate if ambiguity remains.
candidates.source_boundary: Threshold and seaside setting are artistic staging; Mark describes Jesus entering a house.

candidates.subject: Deaf man Mark 7:32-35
candidates.likeness: Strong Christ identity; man has distinctly shorter tightly curled hair, grayer beard and different face.
candidates.gaze: Jesus looks upward coherently; man's attention toward Christ is natural. No malformed pupils seen.
candidates.anatomy: Resting hands and man's raised hands are plausible, with no evident extra digits.
candidates.source_boundary: Suitable as an artistic moment around the healing and upward look. Image does not show fingers in ears or touching tongue; caption must not claim those actions are visibly occurring. Avoid claiming it reconstructs the exact instant of every sequential action. Scenic location and seated posture are artistic.

candidates.subject: Martha and Mary Luke 10:38-42
candidates.likeness: Christ strongly recognizable; sisters are distinct from each other.
candidates.gaze: Christ looks up toward standing Martha; Mary also attends toward the conversation. Natural coherent eyes and expressions.
candidates.anatomy: Christ's gesturing hands, Mary's clasped hands, Martha's bowl support and visible feet are plausible.
candidates.source_boundary: Seated Mary and serving Martha support account. Bowl, furnishings, clothing and precise room are artistic details; no food menu or facial emotion should be presented as recorded.

candidates.subject: Sower seed on path
candidates.visual: Birds pecking visible scattered seed on compacted path clearly communicate seed being eaten. Bird bodies, beaks and visible feet are plausible. No human identity concern.
candidates.source_boundary: Bird species, exact seed variety and landscape are illustrative choices, not specified facts.

candidates.subject: Sower rocky ground
candidates.visual: Wilting shoots and rocks communicate stress, but extensive roots are visibly hanging exposed over rock faces. This reads as uprooting or severe erosion rather than plants with shallow roots in a thin soil layer. Strong exposed-root focus risks teaching a different mechanism than lack of depth.
candidates.recommendation: Show withering cereal shoots rooted in a thin natural soil layer over bedrock, roots largely concealed or confined to a clear intentional cutaway. Avoid long bare root bundles dangling above ground.
candidates.source_boundary: Illustrate shallow soil and withering without adding erosion as if part of the parable.

candidates.subject: Sower thorns
candidates.visual: Dense thistles surround cereal stems, but several central ears are large and filled with plump developing grains. This appears fruitful despite weeds and weakens the intended choked or unfruitful outcome.
candidates.recommendation: Use dense thorn growth visibly overwhelming sparse, stunted cereal shoots without plump full grain heads; small barren or aborted heads are acceptable. Preserve understandable contrast against abundant good-ground harvest.
candidates.source_boundary: Do not caption this currently fruitful-looking crop as a clear depiction of yielding no fruit.

candidates.subject: Sower good ground
candidates.visual: Abundant mature golden cereal heads clearly communicate fruitful growth; coherent field and plants, no evident blocking defect.
candidates.source_boundary: Image illustrates abundance; it cannot visually verify exact thirty-, sixty-, or hundredfold yield.

candidates.subject: Lost coin searching
candidates.gaze_anatomy: Woman's downturned eyes fit attentive searching. Lamp support and broom grip are plausible. Lit oil lamp, sweeping broom and visible coin near wall make the action clear.
candidates.continuity: Blue garment, cream scarf, dark hair, brow/nose structure and approximate age support continuity with found-coin candidate despite changed angle and expression.
candidates.source_boundary: This is a parable illustration, not a historical portrait. Visible coin can represent the moment of discovery while sweeping; do not caption as proof she cannot yet see it.

candidates.subject: Lost coin found and shared joy
candidates.gaze_anatomy: Central woman looks joyfully toward companion; side figures respond naturally. Open palm and single coin are plausible; other visible clasped and chest-level hands show no obvious extra fingers.
candidates.continuity: Central woman is sufficiently consistent with searching woman in clothing, hair, facial features and age; smile and frontal angle account for apparent cheek-width change.
candidates.source_boundary: Friends/neighbors and shared rejoicing fit the parable. Number of companions and doorstep setting are artistic choices.

overall: Six candidates pass technical review with stated caption boundaries. Syrophoenician gaze, rocky-ground roots and thorn-choked crop require revision. Technical review is not owner approval.
